      "options": [
        "x_i = target_i - early_i + late_i with early_i, late_i >= 0",
        "x_i = target_i - early_i + late_i with early_i, late_i >= 0 and early_i * late_i = 0 (complementarity)",

      "evidence": "none (the text specifies separation times but not a big-M constant)",
      "options": [
        "bigM = 500 (large fixed constant)",

        "bigM = max(latest) - min(earliest) + max(separation)"

        0.2
      ],
      "majority_option": "bigM = 500 (large fixed constant)"

        "s_ij is the separation required when i lands before j, stored in upper-triangular row i column j",

        "s_ij is the separation required when j lands before i (transposed orientation)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.3,
        0.1
      ],
      "majority_option": "s_ij is the separation required when i lands before j, stored in upper-triangular row i column j"
    },
    {
      "decision": "landing_time_domain",
      "evidence": "\"The landing times must fall within the specified bounds for each aircraft\"",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals (continuous landing times)",
        "NonNegativeIntegers (whole-minute landing times)",
        "Reals (allowing negative times, though bounds prevent it)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals (continuous landing times)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "order_variable_definition",
      "evidence": "\"The binary decision variables `AircraftOrder[i,j]` are used to determine the landing order\"",
      "options": [

        "Y[i,j] defined only for i < j with Y[i,j] = 1 meaning i lands before j",

      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.3,
        0.1
      ],
      "majority_option": "Y[i,j] defined for all ordered pairs i != j with Y[i,j] + Y[j,i] = 1"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_sense",
      "evidence": "\"minimize the total penalty costs associated with deviations from their target landing times\"",
      "options": [
        "minimize total penalty cost",
        "maximize total penalty cost"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.99,
        0.01
      ],
      "majority_option": "minimize total penalty cost"
    }
  ]
